policy: Curated knowledge migration, not a byte-for-byte copy of historical procedures. Original patches, authors, licenses and histories are unchanged; no new hardware acceptance or PS5 implementation is asserted. Source-only: no firmware, raw capture, private mapping, binary release or console action.
license_notes: The unchanged copied C fixture has SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only.
The active patch preserves the original GPL-2.0-only core header and driver notices.
Existing vendor per-file terms and original patch headers remain authoritative; no firmware license is reassigned.

portable_contract.runner_method: new host-only wrapper; extracts the complete new-file hunk from the active patch and compiles/runs the original C fixture with a native compiler
portable_contract.hardware_limits: Pure helper tests do not establish hardware DMA ordering, error-bit injection, lifecycle, firmware-free boot pairing or PS5 support.

excluded_artifact_groups.reason: Raw UART captures are not part of the source handoff.
Historical generated kernels/config snapshots/boot files are not active source inputs.
Binary initramfs/firmware acquisition belongs to a reviewed boot or distro workflow.
Loader/payload binaries are outside the kernel import.
Unreviewed images are not required to build or understand the active kernel.
Firmware binaries are neither embedded nor redistributed by the active target.
